title: Claude Haiku 5.5 cuts the cost of high-volume AI work
friendlyTitle: Anthropic launches a faster, cheaper Claude model
summary: Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5 for fast, repetitive and cost-sensitive work, saying average running costs are about 75% lower than Haiku 4.5. It also halved Sonnet 5.5 cache-read prices and added monthly API credits for Max and Team subscribers.
friendlySummary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is made for quick jobs that happen many times. Anthropic says it costs much less to run than the older Haiku model.
whyItMatters: Lower model costs make it more realistic to use AI for frequent tasks such as summaries, classification, support and narrowly scoped subagents. Teams should still test the model on their own work rather than treating vendor benchmarks as a guarantee.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make everyday AI tools cheaper to operate. Test it with your own tasks before moving important work to it.
